title: Sources: Anthropic is aiming to go public the week of November 16 and could raise ~$100B at a $1.5T to $2T valuation, after initially preparing for October (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Sources: Anthropic is aiming to go public the week of November 16 and could raise ~$100B at a $1.5T to $2T valuation, after initially preparing for October — Anthropic didn't reveal the valuation it is targeting or the number of shares it plans to sell — Anthropic filed its IPO paperwork …
contentText:
Wall Street Journal :

Sources: Anthropic is aiming to go public the week of November 16 and could raise ~$100B at a $1.5T to $2T valuation, after initially preparing for October   —  Anthropic didn't reveal the valuation it is targeting or the number of shares it plans to sell  —  Anthropic filed its IPO paperwork …
